name: ortho-trim
label: Ortho Trim (mobile)
author: Whitewater Rescue Institute
description: Invisible map companion: on phones, removes KML ground-overlay layers from the map the instant the webmap adds them (hidden Overflights KMLs still downloaded 31 MB of Nova PNGs per open) and turns off tiled-imagery orthomosaic layers after load. Client-side only: the saved webmap and desktop users are untouched.
